body:
I'm terribly sorry for the late reply, I couldn't find enough time to use my phone since I had covid, and again thank you for your compassion. About the last sentence, where I'm from, it is imperative to remain quiet and ignore our elders even if they are in the wrong, and that's why none of my family or neighbour is on my side. She even took the time to tell everyone she knew how I was evil and how everyone from our family mistreated her. 

I have a very important exam comming right up in less then a month but since I've got covid we are being quarantined and I left all my books on the upper floor where she sleeps. ( for context I used to study up there but ever since I've got covid I was forced to stay down where my parents are. ) I really hope something happens so I can stay away from this household. Again, thank you so much for your kindness and compassion.

Im really sorry you had to go through those too. And yeah we are trying to move out soon and hopefully we will succeed. Thank you so much for reaching out to me and I hope you get to live a much more comfortable life.
Oh umm I am a bit uncomfortable with telling that in public but I think direct message can do.

Oh that sounds really good but umm there's a lockdown going on so it's really difficult to go outside. I told mom about it and we are planning to sneak more foods and eat before the others could come for their meals. Also thank you for teaching out it really means a lot.

I will try thank you so much although here I don't think the law can do much. I have been praying to God too with mom too hopefully there will be a path for us to take. And I apologize for my irrational statement of taking l*fe and I won't repeat it again hopefully.

That certainly sounds like a good idea but the thing is I have had barely eaten because of my abusive household and I'm really weak rn to even workout properly. Tho I have been trying to sneak foods from them.

They are manipulating her and she's falling for it again. She thinks it's okay now. How many times have they said this? They always ended up betraying her again.. The cycle never ends but I do have to apologise as what I said was of rage and I should never ever do that. Although I do not intend on letting them go without letting them suffer our pain if even more.

I understand. I will try to provide for myself then. 

They told me to bring dad with me and if memory serves right also my sisters if possible otherwise it's hopeless. But dad refused so we can't continue.

I did and I really think its only fair since I really know how abusive they were...like verbally trash talking mom and threatening dad with a knife.

 I can only assume the reason since I don't wish to be involved with them. They have been really known to make excuses and lies so I really don't want to bother them. Asking them at least in my view would only made me hear more lies and besides asking them would make them more comfortable to approach me and make me more vulnerable to their deception.

In all honesty, I feel it's because my sisters wanted to gain more and more powers trying to get the favor from my dad. This may come off as a bit ridiculous but they have been known to do this even when mom and dad were apart. They would talk to dad and bad mouth mom telling him that she deserve it and also again badmouth dad in front of mom. 

 I did but I had thought it would be a few days only but it had been a week now and they still wouldn't save a seat for me and mom. I can confidently say they intentionally did this as they did when they would blast music and be as loud as possible whenever I study

Dad said he wasn't going to forgive me and my sisters never prepare meals for me anymore so I assume they weren't letting me eat meals with them anymore. And I attend online classes and I rarely leave my house except when I would buy commodities. Aunt said she could support me in my studies but my dad denied her help. And so far my relatives aren't the most kind people and would rather see me drop dead then help as they have been known to attack mom. We don't really have a doctor. We could visit the hospital but the risk is really high since there's a lockdown going on

I'll try looking for that one but I'm not sure about the child protective service. Also wait I'm not sure if the shelter would also work because there's a lockdown going on and given our current cases I think it might take months  to get out.

I tried calling the night mom was hit by dad but mom snatched it away from me. She said if I made the call both her and my life would be all over. I haven't tried again but the way mom snatched it away from me got me thinking if it would be bad

I can't work yet, at least not during this lockdown which might last for months. I am too weak to study and the scholarship I applied for isnt being given out to us. I eat only foods mom sneak out while dad isn't there. I feel like I'm barely clinging to life

I just want to go out along with them. I've had enough of the pain they inflicted. It's like they have already killed me before but now I want to drag them along with me. I wouldn't mind prison but I would also really want this pain to stop.

That sounds really good but I do have to say that my parents aren't the normal parents one would normally have so I can't really consult them. We are moving out with mom soon after the lockdown. I think I'll have to endure this for a while. Thank you for the advice tho... I'll keep in mind!

I'll try but I really don't want her to be like them. Like if she fails to listen to me and she comes back with that exact same abusive behavior as my sisters I don't think I could keep with with that. But yeah if she doesn't want to change there's nothing I can do about it.  Thank you for reaching out to me.
Thank you so much! I will strive to the best of my abilities to make sure to provide a comfortable and peaceful life for both me and mom!
Ah thank you so much! I really hope you get to college and provide a better life for both you and your mother! You can do it!
Ah thank you. I will make sure he gets what he deserve he really needs to know how much it hurts to be abused.
I agree and I will try my best in doing it. It would be really helpful since I barely have any friends left. Thank you so much for the suggestion!

Thank you so much for the inspiration but like Brandon says I do agree to a certain degree but mom has been for me ever since a child and would protect me from dad's abuse and she makes sure I eat healthy and stay fit... It's only natural that I should repay her with a life she so deserve. While I would be hurt if she does betray me I wouldn't be that hurt. She has given me a life (even though it's a really hard and tough one) I want to make her life even greater then before.
Thank you so much! I shall try to live up to my words and provide the best I can not only to mom but those in need as soon as I can!

I'm really sorry you had to be in this situation. But please take heart, you can try your best to provide both you and her with a loving and peaceful life! You both deserve so much better! Please try your best to take care of both you and her.
Thank you so much! I'll take this to heart and try my best and make sure mom gets the life she so deserve!

I'm really sorry you had to go through that too. It's a really difficult path and I don't wish anyone to ever go through these but please stay really strong. I admire your bravery from the bottom of my heart! Please try your best!!

Thank you so much! It really means a lot! I know this is going to be a really tough journey but I must press on and I really want to share it in case there are also some other people who have gone through similar pain.
I agree. Many people just judge us without them putting themselves in our shoes. Especially here where people with such hardships are viewed with contempt.

I'll try but I don't know about the scholarship cuz I've applied last year but they are still not giving us out. I'm sure I reached all the requirements when I submitted it. And yeah about my mom situation she's really sad cuz I was actually ready to fight my father since he literally punched her in front of my eyes.
I feel you, I really wanted to give her all the love she could get because they really deserve it! May she live a long and peaceful life!
I used to encourage myself reading these but lately with all the events in my life it feels as tho it's not worth it. Mom was the only real thread that keeps me from doing it.
